env.description: With a ref and a workflow, variables its steps see, over the workflow's own of the same names.

ref.description: The ref to run: a branch or a tag by name, or in full.

pull.description: Or the dev.knotless.pull record whose head to run.

repo.description: The repository's dev.knotless.repo record, as dev.knotless.getRepo takes it.

workflow.description: The one workflow to run, by name.

errors.name: AuthenticationRequired
errors.description: No account is logged in to the pages, or its session has ended.

errors.name: UpstreamFailure
errors.description: Nothing was asked, as the reason says: the account is not the owner, the repository names no runners, or what was named is not there.

main.description: Writes a dev.knotless.rerun record, as `knotless run rerun` does, in the account logged in to this appview's web pages, which must be the repository's owner: its runners run the ref, or the pull's head, again where it points when they read it. Name one ref or one pull. With workflow, only that one: of the pull's, or at the ref, one that runs on a push to it or whose trigger is to be asked for, its steps seeing env. Requires the session cookie the pages' login sets.

description: Asks a repository's runners to run a ref's or a pull's workflows again, as the owner logged in to this appview's pages.
